title: wysiwyg-hax
description: Integrates HAX as the editor inside a page's form field

attributes.name: hide-panel-ops
attributes.description: Hide the panel operations (save and cancel),

attributes.name: element-align
attributes.description: Direction to align the hax edit panel

attributes.name: body-value
attributes.description: Data binding of a hidden text area with the value from the hax-body tag

attributes.name: allowed-tags
attributes.description: allowed Tags, usually as dictated by the input filtering layer of the backend system that HAX is riding on. While not fullproof, this at least will enforce front-end filtering to match what actually is going to be allowed to be saved in the first place.

attributes.name: app-store-connection
attributes.description: Connection object for talking to an app store.

attributes.name: saveButtonSelector
attributes.description: Object reference that will get clicked on

attributes.name: field-id
attributes.description: fieldId, id value on the input field.

attributes.name: field-name
attributes.description: fieldName, internal to the form in whatever system it's in.

attributes.name: update-page-data
attributes.description: Page data, body of text as a string.
